choose.when:
SELECT YMDHMS, CAST(YMDHMS AS DATETIME) AS DT_YMDHMS,
FROM CM_IF_PERF_1 A, CM_DEV20 B , (SELECT CODE_ID, CODE_VALUE1, CODE_VALUE2 FROM CM_CODE10 WHERE CODE_KIND = 'WORK_TIME' AND CODE_ID != '0' AND USE_FLAG = 1 AND CODE_ID = #{timeId}) WT
WHERE A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN #{date1} AND #{date2} AND A.YMDHMS BETWEEN CONCAT(#{date1}, #{time1},'00') AND CONCAT(#{date2}, #{time2},'59')
AND SUBSTR(A.YMDHMS, 9) >= WT.CODE_VALUE1 AND SUBSTR(A.YMDHMS, 9) < WT.CODE_VALUE2
AND A.MNG_NO = #{mngNo} AND A.IF_IDX = #{ifIdx} AND A.MNG_NO = B.MNG_NO AND A.IF_IDX = B.IF_IDX ORDER BY YMDHMS
choose.otherwise:
SELECT YMDHMS, CAST(YMDHMS AS DATETIME) AS DT_YMDHMS,
FROM CM_IF_PERF_2 A, CM_DEV20 B
, (SELECT CODE_ID, CODE_VALUE1, CODE_VALUE2 FROM CM_CODE10 WHERE CODE_KIND = 'WORK_TIME' AND CODE_ID != '0' AND USE_FLAG = 1 AND CODE_ID = #{timeId} ) WT
WHERE A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN #{date1} AND #{date2} AND A.YMDHMS BETWEEN CONCAT(#{date1},#{time1},'00') AND CONCAT(#{date2},#{time2},'59')
AND SUBSTR(A.YMDHMS, 9) >= WT.CODE_VALUE1 AND SUBSTR(A.YMDHMS, 9) < WT.CODE_VALUE2
AND A.MNG_NO = #{mngNo} AND A.IF_IDX = #{ifIdx} AND A.MNG_NO = B.MNG_NO AND A.IF_IDX = B.IF_IDX ORDER BY YMDHMS
